cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with antepartum hemorrhage who delivered in three teaching hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia between January and June 2018.
finding: The prevalence of APH was 3.7% of all deliveries, with abruptio placenta being the most frequent cause, and high rates of perinatal mortality, postpartum hemorrhage, and anemia were observed.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most common route of delivery for women with APH (62.5%).
